title: UFF-SLFA v1.0.0: A Preregistered Sky-Lattice Falsification Audit
description: A preregistration-ready, selection-aware framework for testing claims that astronomical catalogue anomalies cluster around fixed celestial nodes. UFF-SLFA freezes coordinates, anomaly definitions, holdout rules, null models, multiplicity correction, effect thresholds, and decision criteria; validates every geometric null transform with proper-rotation and lattice-invariance checks; and writes hashed artifacts that support independent numerical replay. The framework tests only the exact catalogue-level association claim and does not infer a causal ontology.
